title: Automatic Reviewers Fail to Detect Faulty Reasoning in Research Papers: A New Counterfactual Evaluation Framework

bias_targets.methodology: Applying soundness-neutral counterfactual edits to research papers, such as active-to-passive voice conversions, American-to-British spelling changes, and injecting minor spelling and grammar mistakes, to test whether automatic review generators change their evaluations based on linguistic style and surface-level text features rather than scientific merit.

Altering the layout of research papers by randomly multiplying whitespaces and relocating figure captions and tables to the end of the document to measure the impact of document presentation and structural changes on automated reviews.
